scope.description: Whole inkscape application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Vector drawing/editing, shapes/paths, text, styles, layout, diagrams, raster/vector import and export.

coverage.rationale: Technical diagram publication is a narrow slice of general illustration and SVG editing.

scope.description: Technical block diagrams and intent-driven directed flow diagrams with declared layout requirements.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Dependencies can determine ranked layout and connectors, while measured layout requirements express outcomes; explicit block diagrams still need coordinates.

limitations: Bounded boxes/links and left-to-right routing; no general SVG import, typography, arbitrary styling or routing optimiser; connector crossings are unassessed.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
